blocks.text: ROTTERDAM, Netherlands— Daiki Hashimoto of Japan soared to gold during the men’s all-around final at the world gymnastics championships on Thursday, sealing his fourth straight title with a brilliant performance on high bar in the final rotation. The 25-year-old Hashimoto’s total of 85.988 included a 14.766 on high bar, even though he could have opted for a slightly safer routine to assure himself of the top spot on the podium. READ: Japan wins men’s team gold at world gymnastics championships That’s simply not how Hashimoto, the 2020 Olympic all-around champion, goes about his business.
